overview:
Last updated: Thu Apr 30 2026

OVERVIEW

Ventura County CA SO uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Ventura County CA SO utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Ventura County CA SO utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
